topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outline the session's core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how intrinsic genetic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations drive clonal selection and cellular transformation.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cancer stem cell paradigm and present experimental evidence identifying the cellular origins of malignancy.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependence in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory signals and supportive stromal interactions promote neoplastic progression and sustain established tumors.

topics.label: Technological methods for investigating tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the experimental, sequencing, and computational approaches used to resolve the spatial and temporal dynamics of tumor evolution.

topics.label: Integrative synthesis of evolutionary factors in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental dynamics converge to drive malignant cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: These closing remarks conclude the session and preview the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
